_notes: Rewritten rules text for the Iconic Weapons chapter; `npm run build:original` swaps in Corgo's wording. `mods` are itemUpgrades for weapons, keyed by heading. `weapons` holds the rewritten Special Features per heading, plus optional overrides (name, dv_table, notes) the way text/weapons_rules.json does. `series` holds each variant series' shared rule and `variants` the per-member rules. Iconics carry Category and Fabrication instead of a Cost; the builder maps the category to that tier's eurodollar benchmark.

mods.FIRECRACKER: Everything the weapon fires now carries damage through destroyed Cover the way an Explosive does, and ablates 1 more SP whenever it ablates at all. On a weapon whose ammunition already behaves like an Explosive against Cover, damage to Cover, and only to Cover, doubles instead.
mods.HACKATOMY: Land a random Critical Injury - not a called shot like a Leg Aimed Shot - on a target with a Neuroport and the user picks one DV6 or DV8 Quickhack to fire into them, Netrunner or not. Do it on an Aimed Shot and the pick widens to DV6, DV8 or DV10. The Quickhack's effect and damage land separately from the Critical Injury and its bonus damage.
mods.SEVERANCE: An Aimed Shot with the weapon against a Seriously Wounded target lands as though they were Mortally Wounded: automatic Critical Injury, Death Save Penalty up by 1. Against a target already Mortally Wounded, the user picks the Critical Injury for the relevant location rather than rolling for it.
mods.WALLPUNCHER: A charged Tech Rebuild attack with the weapon deals 1d6 more Single Shot damage, raises its Autofire rating by 1 if it has one, sees and shoots through one layer of Thick Cover for a weapon that couldn't already, and ablates 2 more SP whenever it ablates at all.

weapons.AGAOU: On an Aimed Shot, 5s on the damage dice count as 6s for Critical Injuries. A Head Critical Injury from this weapon also carries the Improved EMP Ammunition effect, dealing only 4d6 and bursting across a 6x6m/yds area (3x3 squares) centred on the victim. Thrown, it still halves SP.
weapons.BABY BOOMER: Against a target this weapon already damaged earlier in the same Round, 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. If it damaged a target last Round without landing a Critical Injury, then on its next damaging attack against that target, 3s, 4s and 5s all count as 6s.

BFC-9000.rules: On its first attack each Round, 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Every Critical Injury it lands carries 3 more bonus damage (8 total) and cuts the victim's MOVE by 2, minimum 0, for 3 seconds (1 Round). Land a Critical Injury, or damage a head with an Aimed Shot, and the victim needs a DV19 Concentration check or takes -2 on all Actions through the end of their next Turn.

weapons.BLACK UNICORN: Attacking with it, the user ignores every attack check penalty they are carrying from armor, being Facedown, a Critical Injury, or a Wound State.
weapons.BLUE FANG: Its cartridge holds 4 doses of Experimental Neurotoxin, 100eb for a spare. With a cartridge in, attacks deal no damage at all: a meat target that is hit needs a DV19 Resist Torture/Drugs check or the neurotoxin takes hold, cutting MOVE and DEX by 3, minimum 0, for 3 seconds (1 Round). An Aimed Shot to the head pushes that check to DV21 and stretches the effect to 6 seconds (2 Rounds). With no cartridge loaded it hits like any Medium Melee Weapon.
weapons.BUTCHER’S CLEAVER: One of its three damage dice may treat a 5 as a 6 for Critical Injuries, so 5 and 6 crits but 5 and 5 doesn't. If it landed a Critical Injury last Round, or attacked someone already carrying one, the bloodthirst takes over: ROF 2 and Excellent Quality until that lapses. It can't be thrown.
weapons.BYAKKO (WAKAKO’S SWORD): Having moved at least 6m/yds this turn, the user may make a Leaping Strike: 4m/yds forward, half of the weapon's ROF 2, no MOVE spent, 4d6 on a hit. Bring a target to 0 HP or lower and sacred power runs for 9 seconds (3 Rounds), opening the Renzokuken - a ROF 1 attack, never an Aimed Shot, never in a Grapple. Renzokuken: a Melee Weapons check at -4 against the target's Evasion. On a success, roll 3d6 dropping the lowest, then multiply by how much the check beat Evasion, capped at half the user's Melee Weapons Level rounding up. Miss and the user spends an Action next turn recovering before anything else. A landed Renzokuken counts as two Melee Weapon hits toward Martial Arts Special Move prerequisites.
weapons.CARETAKER’S SPADE: Below BODY 10 it costs the wielder 2 MOVE. At BODY 12 or above, anyone it hits needs a DV15 Athletics check to stay on their feet. If its damage would drop a target below 1 HP, the user may leave them unconscious at 1 HP instead. Either way - below zero or unconscious - the user gets 10 HP back.
weapons.COCKTAIL STICK: While the user has Optical Camo, FBC Chameleon Coating or an M97 Ghostsuit running, every attack from this weapon carries the Hyper Expansive Ammunition effect, including the one that breaks the camo. Its Critical Injuries also cut the victim's MOVE and DEX by 2 for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) and bar the Run and Jump Move Actions, on top of the usual damage and effects.
weapons.COTTONMOUTH: When its damage gets through armor, the user chooses whether the target also takes the EMP or the Poison Ammunition effect; either one lands at most once per Round from this weapon. Its Critical Injuries carry 5 more bonus damage (10 total). If its damage would drop a target below 1 HP, the user may leave them unconscious at 1 HP instead.
weapons.CYNOSURE CROWBAR: It does not halve SP the way an ordinary Melee Weapon does. Against Cover, and only Cover, it deals 1d6 more (4d6). It also gives a +1 Complementary Bonus on any check to force a door, crate or similar lock.
weapons.ERRATA: Damage through armor sets the target Mildly on Fire (2 HP a turn) and ablates 1 more SP (2 total). Having moved at least 6m/yds this turn, the user may make a Leaping Strike: 4m/yds forward, half of the weapon's ROF 2, no MOVE spent, 4d6 on a hit.
weapons.FANG (KURT HANSEN’S KNIFE): Once it has damaged a target, every later attack from it against that target deals 1d6 more (4d6) through the end of the victim's next Turn. A Broken Leg Critical Injury from an Aimed Shot carries 5 more bonus damage (10 total), can't be Quick Fixed, and raises the Treatment DV by 2. Thrown, it uses the Shortbow range table out to 35m/yds and still halves SP.
weapons.GOLD PLATED BAT: 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. While the user is in a rage from any cyberware, street drug or other item, 4s and 5s both count as 6s, and each Critical Injury carries 5 more bonus damage (10 total).
weapons.GWYNBLEIDD: Drop a target to 0 HP and runes from another reality bless the blade for 9 seconds (3 Rounds), adding 1d6 (5d6). While the user is Seriously or Mortally Wounded, any damage die that comes up 1 is re-rolled until it doesn't. Against anyone whose Reputation is at least 2 above the user's, it deals 1d6 more (5d6, or 6d6 while blessed).
weapons.HEADHUNTER: Thrown into a head with an Aimed Shot, a single 6 on the damage dice is enough to land a Critical Injury. A Critical Injury from a head Aimed Shot also applies the Cracked Skull effect, though not its bonus damage, alongside whatever was rolled. Thrown, it uses the Bows & Crossbows range table out to 50m/yds and still halves SP.
weapons.JINCHU-MARU (ODA’S SWORD): Its second attack in a Round against the same target deals 1d6 more (4d6), provided the first hit. On an Ambush from stealth it adds +1 to the attack check, and its first attack that Round deals 1d6 more (4d6) on a hit. With FBC Chameleon Coating or Optical Camo running, 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries; with either running and at least 2m/yds (1 square) moved this Turn, the user may make a Leaping Strike 4m/yds forward, taking half of the weapon's ROF 2, spending no MOVE, for 1d6 more damage (4d6) on a hit. With Speedware running, spending at least one LUCK on an attack with it adds another +1.
weapons.MURPHY’S LAW: Every Aimed Shot deals 1d6 more (4d6), and on Aimed Shot damage 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Each Critical Injury it lands also rolls 1d6 for an extra effect: 1, roll again until two different results above 1 come up and apply both; 2, the victim takes -3 MOVE (minimum 0) for 9 seconds (3 Rounds); 3, the victim is set Strongly on Fire (4 HP a turn); 4, the victim is knocked Prone and takes Cracked Skull even if the attack wasn't aimed at the head; 5, the victim takes -2 REF and DEX (minimum 0) for 9 seconds (3 Rounds) and can't dodge Ranged Attacks; 6, the user gets +5 on their next attack check with it. Under the Night City Tarot DLC, a Tarot from this weapon draws three cards and the user keeps one, the other two going back into the deck undrawn.
weapons.NEHAN (SABURO’S KAIKEN): Thrown, 4s and 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. If the target took a Critical Injury from this blade or from Satori last Round, its next Critical Injury carries 5 more bonus damage (10 total) and returns 5 HP to the user. Unlike most melee weapons not built for throwing, it still halves SP thrown.
weapons.SASQUATCH’S HAMMER: It costs its wielder 2 DEX and 2 MOVE, minimum 2 each, and needs BODY 12 to wield at all - never one-handed, by any means. At BODY 15 or above it deals 1d6 more (6d6). Anyone hit needs a DV19 Athletics check or is knocked Prone. Its Critical Injuries carry 5 more bonus damage (10 total), and it ablates 2 more SP whenever it ablates (3 SP total).
weapons.SATORI (SABURO’S SWORD): If the target took a Critical Injury from this blade or from Nehan last Round, its next Critical Injury carries 10 more bonus damage (15 total) and returns 5 HP to the user. Before it has been drawn in a fight, the user may attempt a ROF 1 Fluid Strike, drawing and cutting in one motion: on a hit it deals 2d6 more (5d6), and 4s and 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Fluid Strike works once per encounter. Wielding or openly carrying it gives +2 on Facedowns against anyone who knows whose sword it is, or +4 if they're Arasaka too.
weapons.SCALPEL: Its Critical Injuries carry 5 more bonus damage (10 total) and apply the EMP Ammunition effect, though only disabling one piece of the victim's cyberware. With a Sandevistan running it gives +1 on Aimed Shots, and on any attack's damage 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. If its damage would drop a target below 1 HP, the user may leave them unconscious at 1 HP instead.
weapons.SIR JOHN PHALLUSTIFF: On an Aimed Shot, 5s count as 6s for Critical Injuries. Each Critical Injury also cuts the victim's MOVE by 2 for 3 seconds (1 Round) on top of the damage and other effects. Land a Critical Injury, or damage a head with an Aimed Shot, and the victim needs a DV17 Concentration check or takes -2 on all Actions through the end of their next Turn.
weapons.STINGER: It counts as permanently coated with Biotoxin. Against a target that took a Critical Injury last Round, the Resist Torture/Drugs check to avoid the biotoxin damage rises to DV21. Against a target that took damage from any Poison or Biotoxin last Round, the biotoxin can land non-dismemberment Critical Injuries - head ones if this weapon hit a head with an Aimed Shot, body ones otherwise - and a single 6 on its damage is enough to land one.
weapons.TINKER BELL: An Aimed Shot to the head that gets damage past armor forces a DV15 Endurance check or the victim drops unconscious on the spot. Its Critical Injuries carry 5 more bonus damage (10 total) and apply the EMP Ammunition effect, though only disabling one piece of the victim's cyberware. If its damage would drop a target below 1 HP, the user may leave them unconscious at 1 HP instead.
weapons.TSUMETOGI: Once a Turn, when its damage gets through armor, the target also takes the EMP Ammunition effect. If its damage would drop a target below 1 HP, the user may leave them unconscious at 1 HP instead.
